resources.string: Start on YouTube if the addon is slow
If the addon hasn\'t answered when a song has to start, it plays from YouTube. When a better copy is found, the player shows a button to switch.
How long a song you tap or skip to waits for the addon before playing from YouTube. 0 s starts on whichever answers first.
When the cache is full, songs that aren\'t in your playlists (local or imported from Spotify) are cleared first.
Frees space used by songs that aren\'t in your local or Spotify playlists
Songs that aren\'t in your local or Spotify playlists will be removed from the song cache. They\'ll download again the next time you play them.
